description: This Java source file defines the class LoanRequestFactory, which provides factory methods to generate pre-configured request objects for loan operations in the Fineract project. These include creating default loan requests, modifying loan details, and generating various transaction requests for testing purposes.

classes.name: LoanRequestFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing methods to generate pre-configured loan-related request objects for testing and operation purposes in the Fineract project.
